**Findings triage — verdict: HOLD** (keeps `finding`; routing label `domain:devx` added, since `content/docs/**` is that lane's surface if this is ever promoted).

**Stale-premise check:** the factual half is already closed. PR #6109 rewrote the now-false "pin unchanged" sentence, pushed the rc.0 window's console range to `f995a452d2ca`, and pulled the two breaking migrations into "Breaking changes & migration". Nothing on the page asserts something untrue today.

**Why held rather than promoted, and this is the decisive reason:** what remains is *release-note compilation* — whether rc.2/rc.3 get their own window sections or the range is re-compiled at the v17 cut. CLAUDE.md's third inlined rule puts that work at release time, centrally, and explicitly out of code PRs (`content/docs/releases/` is the repo's hottest conflict magnet). Promoting this to `pm:queue` would dispatch a dev to accrete exactly the per-PR rows that rule exists to prevent. The issue is correctly filed and correctly *not* actionable as a dispatch.

**Restart condition (so this is not a state nobody can exit):** revisit at the **v17 GA cut**, when the release process compiles the windows — at that point either the sections exist (close as resolved) or the page's self-imposed rule is knowingly dropped and the inviting sentence should go with it. A second trigger: if the console pin moves a **third** time before the cut, re-check whether the pin-range sentence has gone stale again, which *would* be a factual defect and promotable on its own.

Related: #6106 / PR #6109 (forensics + correction), PR #6097 (pin advance), #6099 (the digest-reads-first-section blind spot from the same walk).

**Findings triage round (#4949 discipline): HOLD (`finding` kept, `domain:devx` unchanged) — with the gap re-measured, and it has grown.**

Re-read at `origin/main` `4dd9cbd`.

## Stale-premise check

`content/docs/releases/v17.mdx` has not moved since the repo-wide `7f62706` sweep, so PR #6109's corrections are the current state and they still hold:

- `:2049` — the rc.0 window's console heading does carry the pushed range `4a4829d0ef39 → f995a452d2ca`;
- `:2055-2056` — the "two later pin moves … 129 further commits, enumerated in `console-f5bc4c78be76` and `console-f995a452d2ca`" note is present;
- `:2145-2146` — the rc.1 window's formerly-false "pin unchanged" sentence is rewritten to the fact.

⇒ the page is still **factually honest**; what remains is the structural deviation this issue records.

## What grew

The section headings are still exactly `## Landed since 17.0.0-rc.0` (`:1595`) and `## Landed since 17.0.0-rc.1` (`:2140`) — no rc.2+ window section. Meanwhile the release train has moved on: `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` now carries **`## 17.0.0-rc.4` and `## 17.0.0-rc.5`** sections, and the field reports arriving in objectui this week are against `17.0.0-rc.5`. So the page's window sections stop at rc.1 while **four further RCs have shipped** — when this finding was filed the deviation was "two unrecorded pin moves", and it is now "the window structure trails the actual train by several RCs".

## Why hold rather than promote

Unchanged and still correct: **this is release-note compilation, and release notes are written centrally at release time.** Promoting it would produce exactly the PR shape the repo's hardest documentation rule forbids — a change to `content/docs/releases/` riding in as ordinary queue work. Whether rc.2–rc.5 each get their own window section or the whole range is re-edited into one at the next cut is an editorial decision for whoever compiles the notes, not a dispatchable defect. The two genuinely user-affecting breaking migrations were already folded into "Breaking changes & migration" by PR #6109, so no reader is stranded today.

## Restart condition (sharpened — the previous grading left it implicit)

**The next v17 release cut** is when this becomes actionable and cheap: the compiler is already opening the file, already deciding the window structure, and this finding is the list of what is missing. Concretely, promote (or simply hand the compiler this issue) when either fires:

1. a release-cut task for v17 is opened — attach this as an input, not as a separate PR; **or**
2. someone opens a **docs-only** PR against `v17.mdx` for another reason — the window sections can ride there legitimately, since a dedicated docs PR is the one sanctioned route.

⛔ Boundary restated for whoever eventually acts: `content/docs/releases/` is never touched by a code PR. This finding is an input to the release process, not a work item that can be attached to unrelated work.

**ACCEPT** — PR #6625 (devx seat review, round 2).

What shipped, docs-only, exactly one file (`content/docs/releases/v17.mdx`, +208/−11): three new window sections (`Landed since 17.0.0-rc.2` / `-rc.4` / `-rc.5` open window), each carrying its own Console pin paragraph; the whole pin chain re-seated end to end.

Review notes:

- **Two dispatch premises falsified, both toward "the gap is bigger", both evidenced**: the Console pin has moved **four** times since `785b8a5d432c` (card said two — the endpoint the card inherited from PR #6109 had itself gone stale by two further moves), and **rc.3 exists but records nothing** (one changeset, consumed; its changelog sections no longer survive on main). The dev spanned rc.2→rc.4 and says why in the page rather than emitting an empty section. The rc.3 record-hole class is already on file as #6186 — no new filing needed.
- **#6109's stretched rc.0 heading retired with proof from its own section**: the section's opening paragraph 450 lines above already carried the narrow range, and the "five pin moves" arithmetic matches `packages/console/CHANGELOG.md`. Not a revert — the stopgap's own bridge sentence anticipated this retirement. This is the 「理由已死而文字还在」 pitfall handled correctly: the stopgap's justification died when the sections were born, so the text went with it.
- **Breaking migrations re-seated on the move that actually carried them** (objectui#3233 / #3172 → the rc.2 window, verified by grep in `console-f995a452d2ca`); the rc.1 opening no longer claims breaking changes its pin never shipped.
- **`check:role-word` caught a real ratchet violation on first run** (rc.2 section spelled the retired vocabulary while describing its removal, 2→6); rewritten to the canonical vocabulary rather than exempted. Green after.
- **Shallow-clone honesty**: per-move commit counts are quoted from the pin changesets (written against full history at bump time) and corroborated by the card's own deeper-history measurement — the dev explicitly did not trust `rev-list` on 50-commit grafted clones. That is operational-notes discipline applied unprompted.
- Gates enumerated and green (9 relevant ones listed with outputs), plus an out-of-repo MDX compile of the edited page.
- `skip-changeset` label applied at acceptance (docs-only, per policy — the changeset gate reads live PR labels since #5625).

Ready + auto-merge armed 07:35Z. This closes the loop the page itself promised at rc.1 ("that range needs its own section") — and the convention is now stated in the page, so the next pin move has a place to land.
